title: Design repo-local issue ledger storage, generated views, and evidence index for ops
forbiddenActions: Do not treat Markdown projections as canonical issue truth.
Do not close from discussion consensus alone.
Do not add large raw evidence to main without an archive/publication contract.
Do not bypass specs package contracts for implementation work.
closeCriteria: Ops defines local issue ledger layout and generated view ownership for current and legacy issue records.
Ops defines how evidence indexes reference large proof trees without making projections canonical.
Ops implementation or scripts validate latest-state and detect divergence from specs rules.
Ops gates pass.
requiredEvidence: Ops design or implementation diff.
Issue ledger validation output.
Nix/package checks for any affected ops package.
Review confirms projections do not become canonical state.

title: Implement ops issue ledger validation, fsck, and divergence gates
forbiddenActions: Do not rely on line order instead of recordedAt and supersedes.
Do not close if legacy records hide active issue divergence.
Do not run cleanup before localizer and merge-review gates.
closeCriteria: Ops gate validates v1 issue records, latest state, supersedes chain, branch uniqueness, and blocked/closed state requirements.
Ops gate can report legacy/non-v1 records separately without breaking current v1 validation.
Ops evidence records command, exit status, and relevant logs.
requiredEvidence: Focused test or replay for v1 chain validation.
Nix/package check passes.
Issue record close evidence maps each close criterion to files and gate logs.

title: Plan migration for existing ops Markdown and legacy issue records
forbiddenActions: Do not rewrite or delete legacy issue evidence without preservation.
Do not claim legacy Markdown files are canonical after migration unless represented by v1 records.
Do not close until migration risk and rollback are explicit.
closeCriteria: Ops migration plan inventories existing Markdown and JSONL issue sources.
Plan defines current/legacy boundary, preservation, generated view handling, and rollback.
Plan defines how large evidence directories are retained, indexed, or archived.
requiredEvidence: Inventory output or checked-in migration report.
Review evidence for preservation and rollback.
Issue ledger validation for newly added v1 records.

title: Keep Project Source upload proof operational and distinguish transport from approval
forbiddenActions: Do not claim upload success from filename visibility alone.
Do not treat source-list empty as absence when delayed assistant readback proves readability.
Do not treat transport readback as semantic approval.
Do not use thread file upload, inline source, or base64 source as fallback for Project Source handoff.
closeCriteria: Ops wrappers expose worker-readable proof results with semanticApproval=false and completionApproval=false.
Ops docs distinguish upload route, source-list probe, target-thread readback, and semantic approval.
Regression or live replay covers the 2026-05-26 proof path and known false-positive/false-negative cases.
requiredEvidence: Nix/package check for ops-cdp-core passes.
Regression logs for Project Source proof classification.
Live or replay proof with hashes for source upload, thread creation, delayed assistant readback, env probe, and source-list probe.

title: Harden ops-thread-fsm discussion classification and approval boundaries
forbiddenActions: Do not classify NO_UNRESOLVED_OBJECTIONS as UNRESOLVED_OBJECTIONS through substring matching.
Do not promote discussion-no-objections-confirmed to implementation approval, merge approval, or issue closure.
Do not close without regression tests for marker and structured verdict cases.
closeCriteria: ops-thread-fsm classifies no-objection markers without substring false positives.
ops-thread-fsm output clearly separates discussion convergence from approval and localize readiness.
Regression tests cover marker-only, structured verdict, objections, and missing review evidence.
requiredEvidence: Nix/package check for ops-thread-fsm passes.
Focused regression logs for marker and discussion classification.
Review confirms no approval promotion.

title: Track deferred backend, concurrency, archive, and compression choices for issue ledgers
forbiddenActions: Do not choose SQLite, compression, Git refs, or same-issue multi-agent mutation by assumption.
Do not close until specs/policy owner boundaries are satisfied.
Do not let archive storage make current issue state unreadable from Git-managed records.
closeCriteria: Ops records decision criteria for SQLite/latest index threshold, same-issue multi-agent mutation, compression, archive SLA, and Git ref/tree publication.
Each deferred choice has an owner, trigger, and required evidence.
Current issue operations remain usable without those deferred designs.
requiredEvidence: Design note or implementation issue split for each deferred item.
Specs/policy dependencies are linked.
Review confirms deferral does not block current issue localization.
